trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The skeleton has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that make it have the {@condition prone} condition.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.
